spec:
Update plugins/zzzops/skills/execute-zzzops/SKILL.md (and agents/openai.yaml if needed) so the coordinator does not end its turn while any worker subagent it dispatched, or any op `start` it launched, is still live. It waits on the harness's own handle (Claude Code background agents, Codex agent wait/status), re-inspects after a wait timeout, and only then re-reads `zzzops next`. Distinguish a live worker from a stale lease shown in `running` (lease tip age versus timeout) and point to `abandon`/`start --reclaim` and REPAIR.md for the dead-worker case. If `next` shows the same frontier repeatedly with nothing running, do one diagnostic pass (`show G --json`, lease state) and report a concrete blocker instead of looping. Acceptance: the skill text covers attended and unattended runs, never busy-polls, and uses no synthetic liveness probe or daemon. Dropped versus the old wording: heartbeat probes, CLI monitor fields and worker-process identity (R10).

Migrated from GitHub issue #519 after the engine reset (#740).
title: Execute skill: keep the turn alive while workers or ops are running
